q: Who makes the laws in Canada?
zq: 在加拿大，法律由誰制定？
e: Laws are made by elected representatives; courts settle disputes; police enforce the laws.
ze: 法律由民選代表制定；法院解決糾紛；警察執行法律。

q: What are Canada's laws intended to provide, according to the guide?
zq: 根據指南，加拿大的法律旨在提供什麼？
o: Order in society and a peaceful way to settle disputes
zo: 社會秩序與和平解決糾紛的方式
e: Laws also express the values and beliefs of Canadians.
ze: 法律也表達加拿大人的價值觀與信念。

q: The blindfolded Lady Justice symbolizes what?
zq: 蒙眼的正義女神象徵什麼？
o: The impartial manner in which laws are administered: blind to all considerations but the facts
zo: 法律執行的公正：除了事實之外對一切考量視而不見
e: The statue stands at the Vancouver Law Courts.
ze: 這座雕像在溫哥華法院。

q: Which court is sometimes called the Court of Queen's Bench or the Supreme Court in a province?
zq: 省裡哪種法院有時稱為「女王座法院」或「最高法院」？
e: Most provinces have an appeal court and a trial court.
ze: 大多數省有上訴法院和審判法院。

q: Which court handles civil cases involving small sums of money?
zq: 哪種法院處理涉及小額金錢的民事案件？
e: Provincial courts also handle lesser offences.
ze: 省法院也審理較輕罪行。

q: In which situation can you ask the police for help, according to the guide?
zq: 根據指南，什麼情況下可以向警察求助？
o: Only if you are a citizen
If there's been an accident, a theft, an assault, a crime in progress, or someone has gone missing
zo: 發生意外、竊盜、攻擊、正在發生的犯罪或有人失蹤時
e: The police are there to keep people safe and to enforce the law.
ze: 警察的職責是保護人民安全並執行法律。

q: Which police force enforces federal laws throughout Canada?
zq: 哪支警察在全加拿大執行聯邦法律？
e: The RCMP also serves as provincial police outside Ontario and Quebec.
ze: 皇家騎警也在安大略、魁北克以外擔任省警察。

q: Do all provinces have municipal police departments?
zq: 所有省都有市警察局嗎？
o: Yes, there are municipal police departments in all provinces
zo: 有，所有省都有市警察局
只有人口超過一百萬的城市
e: There are different types of police in Canada.
ze: 加拿大有不同種類的警察。

q: What does the guide remind you about the police?
zq: 指南提醒你關於警察的什麼？
o: The police are there to help you
e: "Remember, the police are there to help you."
ze: 「記住，警察是來幫助你的。」

q: What role do prisons have, according to the guide?
zq: 根據指南，監獄有什麼角色？
e: Prisons have an essential role in punishing criminals and deterring crime.
ze: 監獄在懲罰罪犯和嚇阻犯罪方面扮演重要角色。

q: Who can act for you in court?
zq: 誰可以在法庭上代表你？
e: Lawyers help with legal problems and act for you in court.
ze: 律師幫你處理法律問題並在法庭代表你。

q: True or false: Judges and politicians are above the law in Canada.
zq: 是非題：在加拿大，法官和政治人物凌駕於法律之上。
e: The law applies to everyone, including judges, politicians and the police.
ze: 法律適用於每一個人，包括法官、政治人物和警察。

q: For how many years has the Crown been a symbol of the state in Canada?
zq: 王權作為加拿大國家的象徵有多少年？
e: Canada has been a constitutional monarchy in its own right since Confederation in 1867.
ze: 自 1867 年聯邦成立起加拿大本身就是君主立憲國。

q: Where does the red-white-red pattern of the Canadian flag come from?
zq: 加拿大國旗紅－白－紅的圖案來自哪裡？
o: The flag of the Royal Military College, Kingston
zo: 京士頓皇家軍事學院的旗幟
e: The Royal Military College was founded in 1876.
ze: 皇家軍事學院創立於 1876 年。

q: In what year did Quebec adopt its own flag, based on the Cross and the fleur-de-lys?
zq: 魁北克在哪一年採用以十字和百合花飾為基礎的省旗？
e: The fleur-de-lys was the symbol of French royalty for more than 1,000 years.
ze: 百合花飾是法國王室象徵超過一千年。

q: Which part of the original Parliament Buildings survived the 1916 fire?
zq: 原始國會大廈哪一部分在 1916 年火災中倖存？
e: The Centre Block was rebuilt in 1922; the Peace Tower completed in 1927.
ze: 中央大樓 1922 年重建；和平塔 1927 年完工。

q: Who donated the Stanley Cup in 1892?
zq: 1892 年誰捐贈了史丹利盃？
zo: 約翰・A・麥克唐納爵士
e: The Clarkson Cup (2005) is awarded for women's hockey.
ze: 克拉克森盃（2005）頒給女子曲棍球。

q: Which sport has the most registered players of any game in Canada?
zq: 哪種運動在加拿大的註冊球員最多？
e: Canadian football is the second most popular sport; curling was introduced by Scottish pioneers.
ze: 加拿大式足球是第二受歡迎；冰壺由蘇格蘭人引進。

q: Adult applicants of what age are exempted from the language requirement?
zq: 幾歲以上的成年申請人免除語言要求？
e: You must otherwise have adequate knowledge of English or French.
ze: 否則必須具備足夠的英語或法語能力。

q: Where was O Canada first sung, and in what year?
zq: 《噢！加拿大》最早在哪裡、哪一年演唱？
e: French and English Canadians sing different words to the anthem.
ze: 法裔和英裔加拿大人唱的歌詞不同。

q: Who was the first Canadian to be awarded the Victoria Cross?
zq: 第一位獲頒維多利亞十字勳章的加拿大人是誰？
zo: 亞歷山大・羅伯茨・鄧恩
e: Dunn served in the Charge of the Light Brigade at Balaclava in 1854.
ze: 鄧恩參加了 1854 年巴拉克拉瓦的輕騎兵衝鋒。

q: Who was the first black man to be awarded the Victoria Cross?
zq: 第一位獲頒維多利亞十字勳章的黑人是誰？
zo: 新斯科細亞的威廉・霍爾
羅伯特・漢普頓・格雷
e: Able Seaman William Hall earned it in the Siege of Lucknow in 1857.
ze: 一等水兵威廉・霍爾在 1857 年勒克瑙圍城戰中獲頒。

q: When is Canada Day?
zq: 加拿大日是什麼時候？
e: July 1 commemorates Confederation in 1867.
ze: 7 月 1 日紀念 1867 年聯邦成立。

q: When is Sir Wilfrid Laurier Day?
zq: 威爾弗里德・勞里埃爵士日是哪一天？
e: January 11 is Sir John A. Macdonald Day; April 9 is Vimy Day; December 26 is Boxing Day.
ze: 1 月 11 日是麥克唐納日；4 月 9 日維米日；12 月 26 日節禮日。

q: Why is trade important to Canada, according to the guide?
zq: 根據指南，貿易為什麼對加拿大重要？
o: Canadians could not maintain their standard of living without trading with other nations
It is required by the Constitution
zo: 不與其他國家貿易就無法維持生活水準
e: Commerce remains the engine of economic growth.
ze: 商業仍是經濟成長的引擎。

q: Which country became a partner in NAFTA in 1994?
zq: 哪個國家在 1994 年加入北美自由貿易協定？
e: NAFTA covered over 444 million people and over $1 trillion in merchandise trade in 2008.
ze: NAFTA 涵蓋超過 4.44 億人口，2008 年商品貿易超過一兆美元。

q: Which of the following is a service industry job?
zq: 下列哪一項是服務業工作？
e: Service industries include transportation, education, health care, construction, banking, communications, retail, tourism and government.
ze: 服務業包括運輸、教育、醫療、建築、銀行、通訊、零售、旅遊和政府。

q: Which of the following is a manufactured product listed in the guide?
zq: 下列哪一項是指南列出的製造品？
e: Manufactured products include paper, high technology equipment, aerospace technology, automobiles, machinery, food and clothing.
ze: 製造品包括紙張、高科技設備、航太技術、汽車、機械、食品和衣物。

q: Which of these belongs to the natural resources industries?
zq: 下列哪一項屬於自然資源產業？
e: Natural resources industries include forestry, fishing, agriculture, mining and energy.
ze: 自然資源產業包括林業、漁業、農業、礦業和能源。

q: A large percentage of Canada's exports are what?
zq: 加拿大出口有很大一部分是什麼？
e: Many areas of the country still depend on developing natural resources.
ze: 國內許多地區仍依賴開發自然資源。

q: What fraction of Canadian exports are destined for the U.S.A.?
zq: 加拿大出口有多少比例銷往美國？
e: Canada and the U.S.A. have the biggest bilateral trading relationship in the world.
ze: 加美擁有世界最大的雙邊貿易關係。

q: The Canada-U.S.A. border is traditionally known as what?
zq: 加美邊界傳統上被稱為什麼？
zo: 世界最長的不設防邊界
e: Millions of Canadians and Americans cross it safely every year.
ze: 每年數百萬加拿大人和美國人安全穿越。

q: Where is the Peace Arch located?
zq: 和平拱門位於哪裡？
zo: 新斯科細亞哈利法克斯
e: It symbolizes the close ties and common interests of the two countries.
ze: 它象徵兩國緊密的關係與共同利益。

q: Canada has one of the how many largest economies in the world, according to the guide?
zq: 根據指南，加拿大是世界前幾大經濟體之一？
e: Canada has one of the ten largest economies in the world.
ze: 加拿大是世界十大經濟體之一。

q: Which countries, besides Canada, does the guide list in the G8?
zq: 除了加拿大，指南列出 G8 還有哪些國家？
o: China, India, Brazil, Mexico, Korea, Spain, Australia
The United States, Germany, the United Kingdom, Italy, France, Japan and Russia
Only the United States and the United Kingdom
Mexico, Cuba, Chile, Peru, Argentina, Colombia, Venezuela
zo: 中國、印度、巴西、墨西哥、韓國、西班牙、澳洲
美國、德國、英國、義大利、法國、日本和俄羅斯
墨西哥、古巴、智利、秘魯、阿根廷、哥倫比亞、委內瑞拉
e: Since 2014 the group has been the G7 without Russia.
ze: 2014 年起沒有俄羅斯，稱為 G7。

q: What agreement replaced NAFTA in 2020?
zq: 2020 年什麼協定取代了 NAFTA？
e: The 2021 guide still says NAFTA; the current agreement is CUSMA.
ze: 2021 年版指南仍寫 NAFTA；現行協定是 CUSMA。

q: Integrated Canada-U.S.A. supply chains compete with whom?
zq: 加美一體化的供應鏈與誰競爭？
e: Canada exports billions of dollars of energy, industrial, automotive, agricultural and consumer goods every year.
ze: 加拿大每年出口數十億美元的能源、工業、汽車、農產品和消費品。

q: True or false: Most working Canadians have jobs in manufacturing.
zq: 是非題：大多數加拿大就業人口從事製造業。
e: More than 75% work in service industries.
ze: 超過 75% 從事服務業。
